:host { font-family: "Inter", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; } .cart-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); z-index: 1001; } .cart-overlay.active { display: block; } .cart-panel { position: fixed; top: 0; right: -440px; width: 420px; max-width: 100vw; height: 100vh; background: var(--color-bg); z-index: 1002; display: flex; flex-direction: column; transition: right 0.3s ease; box-shadow: -6px 0 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .cart-panel.active { right: 0; } .cart-header { background: var(--color-primary); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .cart-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-on-primary); letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .close-btn { background: var(--color-on-primary-15); border: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; cursor: pointer; color: var(--color-on-primary); font-size: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.15s; } .close-btn:hover { background: var(--color-on-primary-28); } .cart-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .empty-cart { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; margin-top: 3rem; color: #aaa; text-align: center; } .empty-icon { font-size: 3rem; opacity: 0.4; } .empty-cart p { font-size: 0.9rem; color: #888; } .continue-btn { padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 0.5rem; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .continue-btn:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .cart-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; padding: 0.875rem 0; border-bottom: 0.5px solid var(--color-border); } .cart-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .cart-item-emoji { font-size: 2.2rem; min-width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; background: var(--color-surface); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .item-info { flex: 1; } .item-info h4 { margin: 0 0 0.2rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text); } .item-size { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #888; margin-bottom: 0.25rem; } .item-info .item-price { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--color-danger); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .qty-control { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .qty-btn { background: var(--color-surface); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-soft); border-radius: 6px; width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.9rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--color-text); transition: background 0.15s; } .qty-btn:hover { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-on-primary); } .qty-num { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text); min-width: 1.25rem; text-align: center; } .remove-btn { background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--color-border-soft); padding: 0.25rem; transition: color 0.15s; } .remove-btn:hover { color: var(--color-danger); } .cart-footer { background: var(--color-surface); border-top: 0.5px solid var(--color-border); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; } .subtotal-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #888; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .total-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text); font-family: Georgia, serif; margin: 0.75rem 0 1rem; padding-top: 0.75rem; border-top: 0.5px solid var(--color-border); } .checkout-btn { width: 100%; padding: 0.875rem; background: var(--whatsapp-brand); color: var(--color-surface); border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .checkout-btn:hover { opacity: 0.92; transform: translateY(-1px); } .checkout-btn:disabled { background: var(--color-border-soft); cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } @media (max-width: 650px) { .cart-panel { width: 100vw; } }
